_comment: One Wistia media hashed-ID per octagon wall, in order (WISTSCR0..WISTSCR7),
running clockwise from the wall on your right at spawn.
These are the first eight media from the 'Lenny Folder'.
The page resolves each ID to a CORS-enabled MP4 at runtime via
https://fast.wistia.net/embed/medias/<id>.json, so only IDs are needed here.
_titles: Lenny - A Better Way to Deliver Video
How to Order Treats Online With Lenny
